scope:
Field-life UI contracts in real Chromium with installed map data.

The private document adapter prepares a funded character, places the camera on
measured clear ground, freezes simulation and introduces a named aid recipient.
Map/terrain HTTP, the production buttons, costs, guards, migrations and browser
storage are real. This is an assisted contract test, not an unmodified playthrough.

checks.name: Funded test character loads installed real geography
Camp footprint is found on production measured terrain
Real pack supplies active geographic vectors
Player-visible BIVOUAC tab and deployment button are present
Deployment UI spends exact finite materials and persists camp
Camp creates actual rendered props and a physical service interaction
Production cooking UI pays recipe cost and produces two rations
Rejected browser save rolls back rest clock, health and supplies
Rest UI advances exactly one hour and spends one water
Rest reduces fatigue while leaving radiation intact
Packing UI retains owned kit and removes deployed camp
Existing kit redeploys without creating or refunding resources
ENTRAIDE exposes an enabled delivery only near the fixture recipient
Delivery UI spends exact supplies and saves a finite receipt
Received delivery becomes disabled and pays its reward once
Real Continue and migration restore camp, kit and delivery ledger
Restored camp remains physically available in its saved geographic scene
No JavaScript exception in the assisted gameplay contracts
Coordinated source HTML remains unchanged during the run
